use_cases: Display rotating customer testimonials on landing pages to build social proof and trust
Showcase user quotes in testimonial sections of marketing websites
Feature customer reviews in product or service pages to increase conversion rates
ai_summary: A testimonial carousel component featuring customer quotes with avatar images and navigation controls. Displays user testimonials one at a time with left/right navigation arrows, using a clean flat design style. Includes stagger animation effects on the testimonial display. Primarily used for displaying social proof and customer endorsements in SaaS, e-commerce, and marketing contexts.
